model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage achieved by three different models—Llama-3B, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as the number of completions (k) increases, with k ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and spans from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), marked at powers of two with tick labels at each 2ⁿ interval. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The Llama-3B model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.42 coverage at k=1 and increasing to about 0.92 at k=256. The Llama-1B model is shown with a dashed green line and triangular markers, beginning at roughly 0.28 at k=1 and rising to approximately 0.88 at k=256. The Llama-1B + FT model is depicted by a dash-dotted light blue line with diamond markers, starting at about 0.25 at k=1 and reaching approximately 0.85 at k=256. All three lines show a steady increase in coverage with the number of completions, with Llama-3B consistently achieving the highest coverage across all values of k, followed by Llama-1B, then Llama-1B + FT.
